summary: Frontend-only hardening verification for 'Kho Ký Ức Gia Đình'. Verified accessibility (exactly one H1 on Home, Timeline, Memory Detail, Upload, Coming-soon, States showcase, and Not-found sr-only H1), aria-labels on icon-only buttons (nav-desktop-search='Tìm trong ký ức', user-menu-trigger='Tài khoản và quyền', upload-event='Sự kiện', upload-branch='Nhánh gia đình'), demo-notice presence, primary CTA 'Đăng kỷ niệm' wording. Permission matrix verified for all 4 roles (viewer / contributor / owner / admin) with correct show/hide of Edit/Delete on owned (mem-tet-2024) vs non-owned (mem-cuoi-2001) memories and Upload permission-denied for viewer. Delete AlertDialog opens, closes on Escape, and delete-confirm navigates to /dong-thoi-gian. Cancel AlertDialog same behavior. Upload full 5-step flow: step0 upload-hint + disabled next, sample selection enables next; step2 (Chi tiết) shows all 4 inline errors (err-caption/err-date/err-event/err-branch) with empty fields; data preserved on back/forward; step3 review renders; publish with 2 files enters publish-partial with per-file retry, retry completes to publish-success (publish-view + publish-add-another which resets to step0). StatesShowcase renders all 9 demo states plus showcase-retry-ack after retry. Coming-soon-badge present on deferred pages. Responsive: no horizontal overflow at 360x800, 390x844, 768x1024, 1440x900; bottom-nav visible <768 with bottom-nav-upload FAB for privileged roles; hidden ≥768.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleContext is in-memory only (useState). Any hard reload resets role back to 'admin'. Not a bug for this milestone (documented as frontend-only demo), but for future consistency across page refreshes consider persisting via localStorage/sessionStorage or a URL query param. This also makes automated Playwright testing across page.goto reloads inherently flaky — SPA navigation must be used.

SafeImage uses `onError` on — the fallback only appears after the browser fully attempts and fails the request. On slow connections this can flash the alt-text/broken-icon. Consider checking url validity synchronously (e.g., empty/null src already handled — good).

Upload.jsx step 1 (preview) has no data to enter but still requires an extra 'Tiếp tục' click to reach step 2 (details). This is 5 steps total which matches spec, but review request phrasing ('Step2 details validation') can be misread as index-2 when it is actually the third step. Consider clarifying stepper labels for accessibility (already good) and testids like `upload-step-2-details` if further test suites will target steps by name.
Upload.jsx: `useEffect` cleanup revokes object URLs only on unmount; restarting the flow via publish-add-another sets files=[] but earlier blob URLs leak until page unload. Minor.
Upload.jsx `startPublish()` iterates a closure snapshot of files. Works today but fragile if setFiles(...) is refactored to defer. Consider iterating from the freshly-built list.

StatesShowcase passes `testId='showcase-image-unavailable'` to SafeImage, which correctly overrides the default `image-unavailable` testid via `testId || 'image-unavailable'`. If external tests want to assert the default testid, add a second demo with no override or expose both testids.
Home.jsx `featured`/`recent` computed at module scope — fine for static mockData but couples to import order; refactor into component scope if data becomes dynamic.
No blocking file-size or MIME validation in Upload.jsx before sample-add — acceptable for mock; document as follow-up when real uploads are wired.
test_credentials: None — no auth. Role switched via user-menu-trigger → role-switch-{viewer|contributor|owner|admin}. Default role = admin. Note: role state does NOT persist across full page reloads (see code review).
seed_data_creation: None — all data mocked in data/mockData.js (memories include authorId; mem-tet-2024 owned by p-anh; mem-cuoi-2001 owned by different author).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only prototype. IMPORTANT: To test role-based permissions, avoid page.goto() (full reload resets RoleContext to default 'admin'). Use SPA navigation instead — either click Link components or dispatch: `window.history.pushState({}, '', path); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));` — then permission-gated UI (upload-permission-denied, comment-permission-note, detail-edit/detail-delete visibility) works as designed. Upload flow: 5 steps indexed 0..4 — step 0 select, step 1 preview, step 2 details (Chi tiết) with validation and upload-event/upload-branch selects, step 3 review, step 4 publish (simulated last-file failure with >=2 files). Publish success screen has publish-view + publish-add-another (resets to step 0). Owned test memory: /ky-niem/mem-tet-2024. Non-owned: /ky-niem/mem-cuoi-2001. StatesShowcase at /bang-trang-thai renders all 9 states inline. The image-unavailable fallback in the showcase uses the overridden testid `showcase-image-unavailable` — the default `image-unavailable` testid only appears when SafeImage is used without a custom testId (e.g., broken memory image in normal cards).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Test-script false negatives (permission checks, upload aria/validation, image-unavailable inner testid) were reproduced and root-caused: (a) page.goto reloads reset in-memory RoleContext state — resolved by using SPA push-state navigation; (b) upload step index mapping (5 steps, not 3) — resolved by clicking upload-next the correct number of times (twice to reach Chi tiết); (c) SafeImage testId override in showcase is intentional per implementation.
